root name: after the first section call the root must read back exactly as the sheet's board.name, or later calls create a duplicate root
deviations: SH-7's (b) is stated in the annotation column, not drawn: §0 gives a state board two frames, one per size (L47-48, L70-71: 89 dark state boards x 2), and (b) changes nothing visible until the next protected action (no grace line: the band label alone, as board 06 draws it; then 403 step_up_required and SCR-006), so both frames draw (a), the row's visible variant and the one its copy key band.locked belongs to.

Route content: the SH-7 row names no route, so the board sits on /admin, SCR-120 (PageHeader 'Overview', §6 L250), which has no primary action (§6 L285): no write in view needs SH-4's 'every other write T2 admin.locked' ruling. Its nine tiles are one neutral color.surface.canvas placeholder (vs fill): they are boards 21-28's, and OV-2 (§6 L275) leaves five tiles' lines and the Audit tile's three rows unspecified, so nothing is redrawn or invented here.
The kit's locked badge carries SH-4's note (assertive once announce.admin_locked); gen_07.py replaces the note with SH-7's (none: SCR-005 announced the unlock). Local override, e42kit.py unchanged.

strip.locked is drawn though SH-7's copy-key cell lists band.locked only: D4 (L117) makes the 'Admin locked' badge and this strip item one event in one tone; D02:114 and :655 make it the strip's first item when the window has expired; SH-7's cleared window shows the same badge (D4); §4 L169 orders it; and D5 (L118) puts the re-unlock in the strip because the band holds no control. gen_07.py STRIP_LOCKED = False draws strip.none instead. Its entry is not announced (SH-7's none), although the new-item rule (§13 L583; D02:692) would make it assertive: the SH-7 row must rule. Proposed spec fix (PR #4138, §4 L187): What renders adds strip.locked first after any critical item (D4), Copy key adds strip.locked, Announcement reads 'none (SCR-005 announced the unlock; strip.locked enters silently)' (or, if D02:692 is to hold, 'assertive once announce.admin_locked', and block-06 changes to match); drop this deviation once that row lands.

strip.locked carries no CMP-012 env badge (a design judgement): it names the shell's own window state, not a slice, and §4 L167-168 gives the badge to each slice's item; board 04 reads it the same way.
Links are colour + position only on the boards: cvsheet v1 texts have no underline.

TopBar, NavRail, RightRail and StatusBar content other than the Admin entry, the env badges and the owner's name is drawn as neutral placeholders (E10-D02 owns it; §1 L97 gives only the sizes); the chrome binds color.surface.app with color.border.subtle dividers (no source names a chrome surface).

Buttons, chips, badges, banners, fields, tiles, tables, menus and dialogs are compositions from tokens: admin controls are 32 px (size.control.comfortable, §4 L176) while the library CMP-001 binds size.control.height (24 px in the file's compact density), and cvsheet v1 cannot set an instance's glyph, fill or border.

gen_07.py fix_strip() patches the kit's strip locally (e42kit.py unchanged; a no-op once strip() does the same): the title's count '(n)' is its own text node in type.num.base (§6 L287; D02:120), the row's gap space.inset.xs standing for the word space and its note carrying the full §14 strip.title string; each 32 px item binds size.control.comfortable (§4 L176; a Tier-1 primitive, so the validator warns once per item; the tokens line lists it, and the kit's 'token:' line is left off the column to keep its footer inside the root); items are named 'CMP-021 Link (composition) · NN' (build notes), not 'item-NN'.
Board names carry Penpot's normalised ' / ' form (E42-D03 / 31 SCR-121 / populated · …) so cvsheet's find-or-create root matches on every section call; §0 L46-47 writes 'SCR-121/populated'.
